points.quote: **`base`**: Generic utilities and UI building blocks with no VS Code concepts.
**`platform`**: Services and dependency-injection infrastructure shared across layers.
**`editor`**: The Monaco text editor, covering the model, view, languages and editor contributions (`contrib`).
**`workbench`**: The full IDE shell and features: layout, parts, services, extension host and API, and feature contributions (`contrib`) such as search, debug, SCM, terminal and chat.
**`code`**: The Electron-specific app, including the main process, utility process and renderer bootstrap.
**`server`**: The remote and web server implementation.

A layer may import only from layers below it. So `base` imports nothing above itself. `platform` may use `base`. `editor` may use `base` and `platform`. `workbench` may use `base`, `platform` and `editor`.
